title: There is no upgrade path from Drupal 7 (but a workaround)
summary: What I didn't realize is, that this module uses a different db table name (profile_regpath vs profile2_regpath), so there's effectively no conversion. Also need to revisit profile_regpath_update_1000 because that runs too early (on the wrong db table). And the same problem occurs with the very problematic profile2 to profile renaming (module disabled, needs hacky workarounds...)
